says: A person works in a checkout of repository W whose docs/adr directory holds one committed ADR, one ADR modified since the last commit and one untracked draft. They select docs/adr (required) and README.md (optional); source.observe reads the working tree, not HEAD, and returns one observation that lists all four files with their state and the digest of the bytes actually on disk, writing nothing. repository.bind records the checkout under W with that observation's digest as its working_bytes_digest; the decisions source is registered with that binding as its evidence and committed with the observed digests; a capture of the modified ADR names that same observation; and preparation.compose records the same working_bytes_digest. Then the modified ADR is edited again while HEAD stays at the same commit. Observing the same selection returns another observation with a new digest for that file, and composing the same preparation request again returns a preparation that records the new bytes and states working_bytes_moved: the unchanged commit does not certify the earlier observation, and nothing resting on it is reported as still holding.
